(MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI TARUN PAGARE, LEARNED GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is repeat (3rd) application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 262/2019 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - Sanyogitaganj, Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 34 of IPC.
Counsel for the State on instructions submits that the complainant is not in jail in any criminal case.
The complainant has given in writing that he is very much available at Indore.
As per the order-sheet of the trial Court, it appears that the complainant is not appearing for recording of the statement before the trial Court.
The next date before the trial Court is 29.07.2023.
Once the police has traced out the complainant and has got written application from him.

The liberty is granted to the applicant to revive the application after the statement of the complainant.
